title: Lamar Jackson on running more this season: Whatever it takes to win

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson on running more this season: Whatever it takes to win
sources.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was less of a threat running the ball in 2025 than at any other point in his career and he's playing in a new offense this season, which is a combination that has led many to wonder about how he'll approach the game in 2026.
